headCoach.name: Coach Jason
headCoach.bio: Coach Jason is a veteran tennis professional and the head of our academy. He specializes in precise mechanical training, competitive player development, and structural drill planning. Whether refining a student's kinetic chain or preparing players for official UTR tournaments, Coach Jason delivers elite, personalized instruction across Katy and Fulshear. His goal is to foster both athletic excellence and a lifelong passion for the sport.

assistantCoaches.name: JoonHa Kim
assistantCoaches.bio: Hello, I am JoonHa Kim and I was the Varsity team captain for two out of the four years at Fulshear High School. One of my favorite things I love about coaching is meeting new kids and finding ways to teach them based on a variety of skills and personalities!

assistantCoaches.name: Mayukh Jain
assistantCoaches.bio: Hello! My name is Mayukh Jain and I have loved playing tennis for the past 4 years of my life. I currently attend Churchill Fulshear High School and play for the school tennis team. Something I love about coaching is the new friendships I make, whether it be through other assistant coaches, or even students my age.

assistantCoaches.name: Dawei
assistantCoaches.bio: Dawei is a varsity tennis player for Fulshear High School. In his free time, he likes to find new food to try out.

assistantCoaches.name: Haofei
assistantCoaches.bio: Hi my name is Haofei and I was on the Tompkins tennis team throughout High School. I enjoy many activities such as running, basketball, and swimming as well!

assistantCoaches.name: Tarun
assistantCoaches.bio: I am a junior at Tompkins High School with over five years of tennis experience and two years of coaching experience. I am an active member of the Tompkins JV Tennis Team and am involved in several school organizations, including robotics. I am passionate about the sport, reliable, and committed to helping others grow their skills on the court.

assistantCoaches.name: Minjoon Kim
assistantCoaches.bio: Hi! My name is Minjoon Kim, and I played tennis for three years at Fulshear High School. Through that experience, it helped me build a strong foundation, discipline, and a deeper appreciation for tennis. My favorite part about coaching is watching my students improve over time and gain confidence in their skills. I enjoy creating an environment where players can grow but also have fun playing tennis.

assistantCoaches.name: Samantha Luo
assistantCoaches.bio: I'm Samantha Luo, a senior at Seven Lakes High School. Although I'm not currently on the tennis team, I love to play with my friends after school. Before that, I was third seed at the Beckendorff Junior High tennis team. As an assistant coach, I aim to bring a positive energy to the court, developing both players' skills and a love for the sport.
